variants.title: A — Paper & Ink
variants.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create a polished LANDSCAPE 3:2 mobile app design concept board for VeriScript, an Android document restoration / OCR / book-from-video application for Nepali, Hindi and English readers. This is an honest UI concept, not an actual app screenshot. Two large flat front-facing Android screen mockups side by side, near-full height, with minimal device frames, no perspective, no hands, no decorative desk objects. They must look implementable and comfortably readable. Overall board: small title top left, the two screens centered, five palette swatches and hex labels in a compact bottom strip. Typography large enough to read; crisp deliberate hierarchy; icon and text together for actions; comfortable 48dp touch targets; clear safe areas. NO promotional dashboard metrics, no subscriptions, no login, no unsupported feature claims, no gradients, no shiny 3D visuals. Screen ONE is Home: wordmark 'VeriScript'; 'Create a document'; main action 'Scan document'; second prominent action 'Book from video'; smaller 'Import image or PDF'; recent file list with small real paper thumbnails and labels 'Study notes' and 'Book chapter'. Bottom navigation 'Home', 'Files', 'Settings'. Screen TWO is book review: back arrow, 'Review pages', '10 pages selected'; clear 2-column grid of four photographed upright textbook page thumbnails with legible selection marks, page labels '01','02','03','04', subtle drag handles, one unselected thumbnail; concise helper 'Uncheck duplicates. Drag to reorder.'; bottom export area labelled 'PDF type' with options 'Image', 'Searchable', 'Typeset'; 'Searchable' visibly selected; wide bottom 'Export PDF' button. Do not put global bottom navigation on this focused review screen. Paper document pages must remain white/light for readability in every theme. Fonts: restrained display typography and readable sans serif body inspired by Mukta with room for Devanagari. Use exact short English strings; no lorem ipsum. This is mobile, not shrunken desktop. Direction A. Board title exactly 'A / PAPER & INK'. Editorial quiet document-library mood, warm ivory canvas #F4F0E6, lighter surfaces #FCFAF4, near-black ink #120E08, amber action #E8A200, muted stone #D9D2C2. Generous margins, understated 1px rules, mostly square geometry with small 8px corner radius, elegant serif on the large 'Create a document' heading only, clear sans on controls. Home has an editorial headline above two broad horizontal action rows with small line icons; recent files feel like a neat reading list, not dashboard cards. Book review has restrained ruled sections. Amber button with very dark text, NO white on amber. Palette strip swatches exactly labelled '#F4F0E6', '#FCFAF4', '#120E08', '#E8A200', '#D9D2C2'. Layout highly practical but warm and distinctive.
